context: A student interviews about a new human-rights agency
purpose: Interview on an agency; teach 設立/総理/国務大臣/局長/副/差別/義務/裁判所

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新しい機関が設立されたと聞きました。
lines.en: I heard a new agency was established.
lines.style: prepared teen opening the interview, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、人権を守るための組織です。
lines.en: Yes, an organization to protect human rights.
lines.style: expert giving a clear summary, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Is it directly under the prime minister?
lines.style: teen probing the chain of command

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 担当の国務大臣の下に置かれます。
lines.en: It’s placed under the responsible minister.
lines.style: expert clarifying the placement, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: トップは局長クラスの人ですか？
lines.en: Is the head at the bureau-director level?
lines.style: teen pinning down the structure, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 副長官が実務を統括します。
lines.style: expert detailing the leadership, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 差別の相談にも乗ってくれるんですね。
lines.style: teen confirming its function, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はい、対応は法律上の義務です。
lines.en: Yes, responding is a legal obligation.
lines.style: expert stressing the mandate, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 揉めたら裁判所に持ち込めるんですか？
lines.en: If disputes arise, can they go to court?
lines.style: teen following the recourse path, tone holding steady through the whole line
